array.string: L="$HOME/.claude/logs/backfill-scheduled.log"; S="$(readlink -f "$HOME/.claude/bin/session-index-backfill.sh")"; O="$(mktemp)"; rc=0; "$S" --quiet >"$O" 2>&1 || rc=$?; head -50 "$O" >>"$L"; printf 'verdict=%s rc=%s script=%s at=%s\n' "$([ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && echo ok || echo FAILED)" "$rc" "$S" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >>"$L"; rm -f "$O"; exit "$rc"
